verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs and CLI market a consistent 'git push to deploy' workflow with the same APIs (preview envs, rollback, gradual rollout, isolated container workloads) across environments, suggesting no platform migration is needed as you scale. However, community evidence contradicts this promise at scale — surprise $10k bills from usage spikes, limited language support tying you into JS/TS, and users citing security/architecture concerns as reasons to migrate off Vercel entirely (e.g., to Dokploy), indicating real friction when moving from prototype to serious production scale.
